name: Roon
summary: Scholar's Landing とともに消えた
> Escaped in the night With Scholar's Landing Remembered here” —Roon's tombstone epitaph
> Roon was a resident of Duviri. According to their epitaph, they disappeared along with Scholar's Landing, one of the Lost Islands of Duviri, when it vanished overnight.
> Their grave can be seen in Titan's Rest. You can read the epitaph by interacting with the tombstone.
